text: {"562":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand implements macro expansion, including expansion of procedural macros during parsing."},"563":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_proc_macro"],"refers":[],"why":"These crates implement the compiler-side procedural-macro mechanism for externally compiled proc-macro crates."},"564":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_proc_macro"],"refers":[],"why":"Procedural-macro loading and invocation, including passing token streams to annotated macro functions, are implemented by the proc-macro expansion machinery."},"565":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"rustc_expand performs the token-stream transformation and incorporates its result into parsed syntax, while rustc_ast defines the AST."},"566":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_proc_macro"],"refers":[],"why":"The proc-macro bridge uses the stable public token-stream representation rather than rustc's internal token stream."}}
